<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="240" height="240" role="img"
     aria-label="10 by 10 grid with one black square at row 6, column 6">

      <path d="M20 0H0V20" fill="none" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="1"/>

  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="200" fill="white" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="200" fill="url(#grid20)"/>
  <rect x="100" y="100" width="20" height="20" fill="black"/>
</svg>

\

Claim: Every $2^n$ by $2^n$ deficient grid can be tiled with trominos.
